name: Fixture Overlay Insert
description: Negative fixture: an extension that inserts a sequential stage into the middle of an order it does not own. Must fail the additive rule (semantics 9.5.5).

patterns.name: Interposed Phase
patterns.description: A pattern the extension wants to run between two phases the owner sequenced.

patternOrchestrations.name: Platform Endeavour
patternOrchestrations.description: The whole life of a platform: sequenced phases, with assurance alongside, sprints inside each phase, and incident response always available.
